A '''winged creature''' with [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] characteristics had a long neck, horned head, red wings and a long tail.<ref name="Inside" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> two of these creatures were kept in a cave adiacent to the main pit that contained [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]], below [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rancor07.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The rancor model fighting a dragon]]
An image often mistaken to be the rancor from {{Film|VI}} battling a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] was in reality, a joke from the crew of [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]]. They placed a model of one of the [[Wikipedia:Dragon|dragons]] from the film [[Wikipedia:Dragonslayer (1981 film)|''Dragonslayer'']] in the arms of the rancor model and took a photo. The photo was included in the book [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>

Creatures based on this dragon were included in [[Richard Chasemore]]'s artwork of Jabba's Palace for ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]'',<ref name="Inside" /><ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> based on what Chasemore called a "cut scene."<ref name="Chasemore">{{ArtStation|username=richardchasemore|url=artwork/r4AwO|name=Richard Chasemore|text=Painted Star Wars Locations}}</ref>
